name: How long does a typical wood fence repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical wood fence repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a wood fence repair depends on the extent and type of damage. Minor repairs, such as replacing a few pickets or a single post, might take a few hours to a full day. More extensive repairs involving multiple sections or structural adjustments could take several days. We provide an estimated timeline after a thorough on-site assessment, ensuring transparency before starting any work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies based on damage severity. Minor repairs can take hours to a day, while extensive work may take several days. We provide timelines after assessment.
